_source: S32K3 RTD 7.0.1 Adc.xdm (C:/NXP/S32DS.3.6.7/S32DS/software/PlatformSDK_S32K3/RTD/Adc_TS_T40D34M70I1R0/config/Adc.xdm) + device+package channel enum Adc_s32k344_mapbga257.epd (same package RTD/Adc_TS_T40D34M70I1R0/autosar/). Fixture: tests/fixtures/nxp/ds/s32k3/Autombd_Test_Adc_S32K344 (ADC0 baseline, ADC source clock 160 MHz). Cache ids: source.s32k3_rtd_xdm.adc, source.s32k3_rtd_epd.adc. Runtime reads ONLY this committed asset -- never raw .xdm/.epd. Code literals in apply.py are pinned to these values by tests/unit/test_adc_apply.py::test_adc_json_matches_apply_code_literals (LL-012).

channel_name_to_id._source: Adc_s32k344_mapbga257.epd AdcChannelName ENUMERATION (literal AdcChannelName, AdcChannelId = integer after 'ChanNum'). There is NO S0..S7; S-channels start at S8. X0..X3 reuse the symbolic name across several ChanNum ids; the .mex stores the full literal, so the key is the full literal.

channel_short_name_aliases._note: Convenience map from the short channel name a user types (e.g. VREFL, S10, P5) to the full AdcChannelName literal used in the .mex. Derived from channel_name_to_id by stripping the _ChanNum<id> suffix. For X-channels the short name is ambiguous (X0 maps to 64..71); the user must give the full literal for those. Only the unambiguous short names are listed here.

enum_domains._source: Adc.xdm enumeration literal sets for the named vars.

cli_enum_map._note: Maps the minimal CLI/intent --spec tokens a cold agent authors to the .mex enum values, so SKILL.md examples stay short. Grounded in enum_domains above.

sampling_derivation._source: Adc.xdm: AdcPrescale enum {1,2,4} DEFAULT 1 (L426-437); AdcSamplingDuration0/1/2 INVALID Range >=8 and <=255 (L3718-3720). ADC source clock for ADC0/ADC1/ADC2 in the Autombd_Test_Adc_S32K344 fixture = 160 MHz (clock_output ADC1_CLK.outFreq, fixture line ~119).
sampling_derivation.formula: AdcSamplingDuration<band> = round(sampling_time_seconds * adc_source_clock_hz / prescaler). Choose the smallest allowed prescaler that lands the result within [sampling_duration_min, sampling_duration_max]. The three bands SD0/SD1/SD2 cover channels 0-31 / 32-63 / 64-95; the same derived value is written to all three because one sampling time is requested for the whole group. AdcChannelSampTime is READONLY/unused -- do NOT write it.

examples._note: Illustrative checks only; the value is always computed from the formula, never read from here.

unit._source: Adc.xdm AdcConfigSet/AdcHwUnit + fixture AdcHwUnit_0. Field order and defaults are byte-faithful to the Autombd_Test_Adc_S32K344 fixture AdcHwUnit_0 so a new unit struct reproduces the vendor shape exactly.

group_defaults._source: Fixture AdcGroup_0 struct (byte-faithful field order/defaults). AdcGroupConversionConfiguration holds SD0/SD1/SD2; AdcAlternateGroupConvTimings holds the alternate bands (left at fixture defaults). AdcNotification array holds the completion callback as <setting name="0" value="<fn>"/>; requires AdcGeneral/AdcGrpNotifCapability=true (fixture already true).

watchdog._source: Adc.xdm AdcConfigSet/AdcHwUnit/AdcThresholdControl (L3934-4090): fields AdcThresholdControlRegister (DEFAULT ADC_THRESHOLD_REG_0), AdcHighThreshold (DEFAULT 16383, <=resolution max), AdcLowThreshold (DEFAULT 0); High>=Low. Channel-level: AdcEnableThresholds gates AdcThresholdRegister ref + AdcWdogNotification. Coherence INVALID rules: L2758 channel thresholds require AutosarExt/AdcEnableWatchdogApi=true; L2761/L204 require the unit's AdcHwConfiguration[AdcHwConfiguredId=<unit>]/WdgThresholdEnable=true; L2791 the AdcThresholdRegister ref must be non-empty and contain the Hw Unit struct name.

bctu._source: Adc.xdm AdcConfigSet/BctuHwUnit (field order L4207..) + BctuInternalTrigger (L4399..: BctuTriggerSource ref, BctuTriggerLoop DEFAULT false, BctuDataDestination enum, BctuHwTriggerEnable DEFAULT true, BctuTriggerConversionMode enum incl SINGLE L4504, BctuAdcTargetMask INTEGER DEFAULT 1, BctuAdcChannelSingle ref, BctuConversionListStartIndex DEFAULT 0) + BctuAdcNotifications (L4657..: BctuAdcNotificationsAdcIndex ref, BctuAdcNewDataNotification, BctuDataOverrunNotification, BctuListLastConversionNotification). Trigger-source tokens + BctuDataDestination enum from Adc_s32k344_mapbga257.epd. Gating: AdcGeneral/AdcHwTriggerApi (any HW-trigger group) + AutosarExt/AdcEnableCtuControlModeApi (gates BctuHwUnit editability/presence, Adc.xdm L4182/L4186/L4203). The fixture already has a placeholder AdcHwTrigger_0; ADC-003 repoints its AdcHwTrigSrc and populates the empty BctuHwUnit array.

hw_configuration._source: Adc.xdm AdcConfigSet sibling array AdcHwConfiguration + fixture AdcHwConfiguration_0 (AdcHwConfiguredId=ADC0). One entry per Hw Unit id. AdcNormalInterruptEnable gates ADC_INTERRUPT transfer; WdgThresholdEnable gates channel thresholds; DmaTransferEnable gates ADC_DMA transfer.

coherence_flags._note: AutosarExt/AdcEnableThresholdConfigurationApi gating (L6709): requires AdcEnableWatchdogApi=true. Listed so a later watchdog-config path stays coherent; ADC-001 does not flip AdcEnableThresholdConfigurationApi.
